attempts.text:
**The window starts at `rcnB`.** Column 0 is spine, carried by 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 1% of calls, and the model names it in 97%. Column 1 is variable, `rcnA`, [[nickel and cobalt efflux]], carried by 88%, named in 94%.

**A short spine follows.** Columns 2 to 4, `rcnR`, `thiM` and `thiD`, are spine, carried by 91%, in a region of plasticity in 7 to 13% of calls; the model names 88 to 97% there, fewest at `thiM`, 88%, with 0.79 bits. Columns 6 to 10, `yegW` to `fbaB`, are spine too, named in 90 to 94%.

**The first fork is at columns 11 to 17**, the stretch most in regions of plasticity: 70 to 92% of calls. The most carried families there are `gatY` to `gatR`, [[tagatose and galactitol catabolism]], carried by 69 to 79%; a second branch of 7 families, in 11 to 13% of chromosomes, all shell, runs alongside. The model names 82 to 96% and hesitates up to 1.12 bits at column 12.

**Then spine again**, `yegS` to `yegQ`, carried by 91%, in a region of plasticity in 22 to 30% of calls, named 82 to 96%. Forks at columns 21 and 24 carry `yegP` and `mdtD`; the `mdtC` to `mdtA` spine, [[multidrug efflux]], is named in 78 to 80%.

**The long fork and variable tail runs to the end.** Columns 28 to 79 are fork and variable, in a region of plasticity in 16 to 89% of calls, named 52 to 93%. The `wca` and `cps` families, [[colanic acid biosynthesis]], are carried by 65 to 71%; branches of 11, 3 and 3 families, in 10 to 13% of chromosomes, all shell, carry phage and lysis genes. The model is most hesitant at column 66, `rfbC`, 1.42 bits, and names fewest at column 68, 52%. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.94 against 0.29 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 91%.

label: rcnB
facts:
WINDOW: the rcnB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rcnB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,603 to 1,682 from dnaA. Read in 531 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rcnB once); 42,480 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 81% of genes, 0.61 bits on average (perplexity 2.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 19,906 calls, named 93%, 0.26 bits; shell 19,137 calls, named 80%, 0.62 bits; cloud 3,437 calls, named 14%, 2.57 bits. Outside an RGP 21,446 calls, named 91%, 0.29 bits; inside an RGP 21,034 calls, named 71%, 0.94 bits. Columns: 17 spine, 36 fork, 27 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.94 against 0.29 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 91%); 21,034 of the 42,480 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 66 (rfbC) 1.42 bits, RGP 78%; column 67 (lpxT) 1.38 bits, RGP 76%; column 65 (wbdC) 1.36 bits, RGP 81%. The 39 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 76%, 0.72 bits on average; the other 41 columns: named 85%, 0.50 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 11-17 (fork), RGP 70-92%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 1%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 1%. Genes: rcnB. named 97%; 0.33 bits.
2. column 1 variable: RGP 7%. named 94%; 0.36 bits.
   1: rcnA P 88% "nickel/cobalt efflux protein RcnA"
3. columns 2-4 (3 columns) spine: share 91%, all P, RGP 7-13%. Genes: rcnR, thiM, thiD "bifunctional hydroxymethylpyrimidin…". named 88-97% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3 (thiM), named 88%, 0.79 bits.
4. column 5 variable: RGP 8%. named 90%; 0.53 bits.
   5: yegX P 86% "GH25 family lysozyme"
5. columns 6-10 (5 columns) spine: share 90-91%, all P, RGP 8-24%. Genes: yegW "UTRA domain-containing protein", yegV "PfkB family carbohydrate kinase", yegU "ADP-ribosylglycohydrolase family pr…", yegT "MFS transporter", fbaB. named 90-94% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 8 (yegU), named 90%; most hesitant at column 9 (yegT), 0.50 bits.
6. columns 11-17 (7 columns) fork: RGP 70-92%. named 82-96% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 11, named 82%; most hesitant at column 12, 1.12 bits.
   a second branch of 7 families through columns 11-17, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11-13%, all S; the branch's families: "MFS transporter", "FGGY family pentulose kinase", "SDR family oxidoreductase", "LacI family DNA-binding transcriptional…", "helix-turn-helix domain-containing prot…", dalD, xylB
   11: gatY S 78%

8. column 21 fork: RGP 23%. named 78%; 0.90 bits.
   21: yegP P 89% "YegP family protein"; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system RelE/Par…" S 22%
9. columns 22-23 (2 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 21-22%. Genes: baeR, baeS "two-component system sensor histidi…". named 89-92% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 22 (baeR), named 89%, 0.50 bits.
10. column 24 fork: RGP 20%. named 90%; 0.31 bits.
   24: mdtD P 88%; also "replication protein" S 12%
11. columns 25-27 (3 columns) spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 17-19%. Genes: mdtC "multidrug efflux RND transporter pe…", mdtB, mdtA. named 78-80% (mean 79%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 26 (mdtB), named 78%, 0.37 bits.
